body:
Calling this callback `onStateChange` would make sense.

A few other APIs exposing an `onStateChange` function:

* [Downshift](https://github.com/downshift-js/downshift#onstatechange)
* [ServiceWorker](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ServiceWorker/onstatechange)
* [YouTube](https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference)
